cards.quote: Just following up on my email from last week.
cards.cn: 就之前的事再联系一下（礼貌地催进度）

cards.quote: Quick heads-up: I'll be out of the office tomorrow.
cards.cn: 提前打个招呼；预先提醒

cards.quote: No rush, but could you take a look when you get a chance?
cards.cn: 等你有空的时候（客气地请人帮忙）

cards.quote: I don't have the bandwidth for this until next week.
cards.cn: 能腾出来的时间和精力

cards.quote: Looping in our designer, who knows more about this.
cards.cn: 把某人拉进来（加进邮件或讨论）

cards.quote: Happy to hop on a call if that's easier.
cards.cn: 一起通个电话或开个线上会
